parts.description: Yellow Jacket planetary gearmotor, 19.2:1, 8 mm REX shaft, quadrature encoder
parts.notes: price $54.99, SKU 5203-2402-0019, stall 24.3 kg.cm (2.38 Nm), free speed 312 rpm, 12 V, 437 g — read from goBILDA 2026-08-28. goBILDA publishes neither a continuous rating nor a loaded speed. rated = stall/3 (the usual thermal derate for a brushed DC gearmotor) and max_speed = free_speed/2 (a DC motor at its torque peak runs near half its no-load speed).
